summary: Ran full local OpenNext SEO regression against http://127.0.0.1:8787 after static-asset refactor. 352 baseline routes were audited; core endpoints/products parity passed, but 24 baseline SEO/routing mismatches remain.

critical.endpoint: Baseline redirect set (15 routes incl. /about-us, /contact-us, /digital-solutions, /gallery, /portfolio, /our-works, several /products/* legacy aliases)
critical.issue: Expected 301 in migration-baseline/routes.json, actual is 308 across these routes (status change from baseline contract).
Baseline marks these as indexable 200 but local worker returns 308 redirects (unexplained gaps vs baseline canonical set).
Page emits robots noindex in normal (non-staging) build, conflicting with baseline indexable expectation.

minor.issue: Canonical serialized as https://brightluxx.com (no trailing slash) while baseline canonical is https://brightluxx.com/.
H1 text differs from baseline source-of-truth entries (case/content mismatch).
Baseline file currently expects 301, but route returns 410 (this appears to be a known behavior from prior iterations and should be explicitly reconciled in baseline set).

integration_issues.issue: Rendered SEO contracts diverge from migration baseline on selected routes (status/H1/noindex).

action_items: Align redirect semantics with baseline policy (either update routes to return 301 or update baseline to approved 308 set).
Resolve 4 indexable routes currently redirecting (or move them to approved redirect set in migration-baseline/routes.json).
Decide and enforce final SEO policy for /compare (indexable vs noindex) and keep baseline/source code consistent.
Reconcile /products/hjdba baseline intent with current 410 contract to remove ambiguity for future gates.
critical_code_review_comments: No `Legacy page asset` runtime errors detected in tested representative pages; static asset binding appears healthy in local worker.
`/app/nextjs/app/[...slug]/page.tsx` explicitly sets `robots: { index: false }` for `/compare`, which is the direct source of current baseline mismatch.
Current behavior strongly suggests baseline-contract drift rather than a broad runtime rendering failure; status contract normalization is the main blocker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary artifact is /app/test_reports/artifacts/iteration_153/baseline_route_audit_summary.json with exact route-level mismatches (24 total). Most failures are redirect status policy drift (301 vs 308), 4 indexable->308 shifts, and /compare noindex. Product/API parity checks passed: /api/products=94, /products SSR cards=94, representative detail routes passed canonical/schema checks.
rca of the issue: RCA indicates policy/contract drift after migration hardening, not asset-binding failure: Next permanent redirects are currently emitted as 308 where baseline expects 301; `/compare` noindex is code-driven in metadata; and some routes classified as indexable in baseline now behave as redirects. Mitigation: normalize baseline + route policy to one approved matrix and rerun full 352-route gate.
